about_title: Byculla, Mumbai - Mumbai's Oldest Zoo, Multi-Community Heritage & A Neighbourhood Reborn
about: Byculla is one of Mumbai's oldest and most historically layered localities. Home to the Byculla Zoo - Mumbai's oldest - the Mazgaon docks, the Jewish Sassoon family's legacy, grand old churches, mosques and temples, it is a neighbourhood where every lane tells a story. Today, Byculla is also one of Mumbai's most exciting real estate transformation stories, with luxury towers rising alongside century-old heritage buildings. Whether you need a dentist near Nagpada, a salon in Mazgaon, or a reliable plumber in Clare Road - Mumbai96 has verified listings with real reviews, direct numbers and everything a Mumbaikar needs to find the right service fast.

character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Byculla is Mumbai's most quietly extraordinary neighbourhood. Walk its lanes and you'll pass a 400-year-old church, a magnificent synagogue, a mosque with a century of history, and a Hindu temple - all within a few minutes of each other. This is not a curated heritage walk. This is just Tuesday in Byculla. The neighbourhood is in the middle of a fascinating transformation. Old chawls and heritage buildings stand next to gleaming luxury towers. The Bohri Muslim community of Nagpada, the East Indian Catholics of Mazgaon, the Maharashtrian families of Chinchpokli and the new-age professionals moving into the luxury developments - they all share the same streets, the same markets and the same deep attachment to a place that refuses to be ordinary.

resident_profile_description: Resident Profile One of Mumbai's most diverse communities - here's who you'll find calling Byculla home. Byculla is perhaps Mumbai's most genuinely multi-community neighbourhood. The Bohri Muslim community has deep roots in Nagpada. The East Indian Catholics of Mazgaon have been here for centuries. Maharashtrian working-class families fill the chawls of Chinchpokli. And now, a new wave of young professionals and investors is arriving, drawn by the luxury towers and the promise of a South Mumbai address at a fraction of the price.

faq.question: What is Byculla known for?
faq.answer: Byculla is known for the Byculla Zoo (Veermata Jijabai Bhosale Udyan) - Mumbai's oldest zoo - as well as its rich multi-community heritage spanning Jewish, Christian, Muslim and Hindu communities, the historic Byculla railway station, and being one of South Mumbai's most culturally layered and rapidly transforming localities.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Byculla?
faq.answer: Byculla has multiple pin codes: 400027 (Byculla East / Mazgaon) and 400008 (Byculla West / Nagpada / Clare Road).

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Byculla?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Byculla are Mazgaon, Nagpada, Chinchpokli, Clare Road, Jacob Circle, Agripada, Dongri, Kamathipura, and the Byculla Zoo belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Byculla?
faq.answer: Property prices in Byculla range from ₹70 lakh for a 1BHK in Nagpada/Chinchpokli to ₹1.5–2.5 Cr for a 2BHK in Mazgaon/Clare Road, and ₹2.5–4 Cr for premium new-development apartments near Jacob Circle. Rental rates range from ₹15,000 to ₹45,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Byculla?
faq.answer: Byculla is served by the Central Railway's Byculla Station (10 min to CST), Chinchpokli Station, BEST bus routes 1, 3, 63, 66, 83, 124, and direct access to the Eastern Freeway via Mazgaon. The area is also well-served by taxis and autos.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Byculla?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Byculla include J.J. Hospital (Grant Medical College), Masina Hospital, Cama & Albless Hospital, St. George's Hospital, and Wockhardt Hospital.

faq.question: Which schools are in Byculla?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Byculla include St. Mary's High School, Don Bosco High School, Holy Name High School, St. Anne's High School, and Anjuman-I-Islam School.
